BLOCKER_offering_classification_dishones.root_cause: thebotwire.com is a MULTI-VERTICAL data/news-wire API. Its manifest/OpenAPI enumerate the industries its news wires COVER (commerce, logistics, hospitality, arts, fashion, ad-tech). Vertical-specific archetype signals (fulfillment, shipping-noun, book, appointment, generations, render) collide with these CONTENT-CATALOG topic words. Distinct from prior guarded minefields ('book a demo' CTA, 'trained on a dataset'): here the collision is a storefront REPORTING ON an industry vs OPERATING IN it. The subscription false positive is the classic negation collision ('No subscription').

decision.reason: The P0's acceptance gate requires replay-clean AND honest classification before install. Replay-clean: PASS. Honest classification: FAIL (4 over-claimed archetypes). The loop rejected polar.sh (6->3 drift), simplybook.me, and www.allbirds.com for lesser classification issues; installing thebotwire.com would make it the FIRST canonical fixture with a dishonest classification (inv #4). The SCORE (86.0, live-x402) is genuine and confirmed stable, so the pin is blocked SPECIFICALLY on the offering-precision pollution, not on the score.
decision.score_only_pin_considered_and_rejected: The 86.0 is off the offering path and no committed test would assert the dishonest classification, so a score-only pin is technically clean. Rejected for consistency with the loop's demonstrated attribution-honesty standard: a canonical fixture whose classifier attributes physical_good/service_booking to a news API is a latent trap for future offering-mining cycles, and every existing baseline fixture classifies honestly. Truth outranks the pitch (playbook capability lens).

next_actions.unblock_path_A_preferred_in_cloud_COVERA: Harden the archetype signals against a data/news API's CONTENT-CATALOG topic words: physical_good (fulfillment / shipping-noun must tie to the storefront's OWN fulfillment, not a news-category enumeration), service_booking (guard the gerund 'booking' + 'appointment' as personnel/arts news), digital_good (generations/render must be an offered good, not an audience/topic), subscription (the NEGATION guard: 'no subscription' / 'no monthly' must NOT claim subscription - the clearest single sub-item). Each with a precision-synthetic guard pair (synthetic multi-vertical news-catalog prose does NOT fire; genuine capability prose still fires) so the existing anchors (moleskine/allbirds physical_good, acuity/simplybook service_booking, polar subscription) stay green. This is designable+executable IN-CLOUD (offering discovery is off the network path - the synthetic half needs no live capture).
